officialManifest.policy: Pinned Oct13 official manifest; exact W30 selected item hashes, not family/element guesses.

displayProperties.description: The speed with which the weapon can be readied and aimed.
displayProperties.name: Handling

inputHashPolicy: Fixed PINS constants; fail closed on drift; never refresh from generated metadata

units.frameConversion: none; handling coefficients are already seconds

policies.official: Exact W40 selected Bungie base stats, equal to W40 runtime and W46 selected official evidence
policies.curve: Historical community approximation; q(x)=evpp*x*x+vpp*x+offset; missing evpp=0 per build.rs serde default
policies.stat: x=clamp(official Handling,0,100), as StatQuadraticFormula::solve_at_i; selected stats already in range
policies.modifiers: Neutral base evaluation only: stat/draw/stow adds=0, draw/stow scales=1; no perks or armor
policies.tickBounds: No additional minimum/maximum tick clamp; reject nonpositive/nonfinite source durations
policies.unsupported: Five swords: supported=false; handling, readyTicks and stowTicks explicitly null
policies.order: Exactly W30 selected catalog order; no clock, network, full inventory or environment-dependent input

limitations: Official base manifest Oct13 2026 and community formula commit May20 2026 are distinct snapshots; no current exact balance claim
Timings are historical community approximations, not official Bungie animation durations
No perks, armor, subclass, masterwork, socket roll, exotic or other animation modifiers
Glaive supports ready/stow only; its zero ADS curve does not make switching unsupported
No sword handling is invented; unsupported runtime behavior belongs to the consumer
20 Hz ceiling is the Minecraft adaptation; unrounded source curves and seconds are retained
